decisions.reason: The firm has invested in established-offer automation and publicly listed the product, with no evidence of persistent failure, so escalation of commitment suggests keeping it.
Although the web tool may be more peripheral, it is publicly committed and builds on established know-how, so management will likely persist rather than write off this early investment.
The product is publicly mentioned and fits the firm's central automation/systems direction, so costly justification and sunk resources make dropping unlikely within a year.
